reviews.snippet: We were heading out from the airport & found this place.They have a tea and snacks counter and a restaurant attached that serves meals. They had a large choice of items for breakfast,from the usual idli,dosa to appams and idiyappam. We were 2 of us so ordered 3 appams each ,half a bowl of veg stew & a full egg roast ,it was really delicious,we kept getting appams straight from the pan. Service was very courteous. They had very clean restroom too.

reviews.snippet:
I and my friend had visited this place for having lunch and the customer service experience was horrible.
We literally had to ask for every basic amenities like tissue paper, spoons etc.
In our case the food was served on time but there were few people who had to wait for 40 mins to get the food served.

There is no restroom and no water was available in the hand wash section. When we informed about the lack of availability of water  to the manager, there was no response from his end as well.
After facing lot of issues, we asked for bill and waited 15 mins at our table, size there was no response we decided to go to the counter to pay bill and they made us wait another 15 mins there.
They would not accept their mistake even after complaining.

In short we had a pathetic experience at this place and I'm sure that we are not the only one who faced this here.

I would not recommend anyone to visit this place.
